## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1]; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stain orders are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong separation; dataset ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha) | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 100th OOD percentile [F6] | Atypical OOD; reliable, 12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (0.76–0.79 similarity) [F5] | Unanimous nearest-neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive driver (+2.05); separates case from InSitu contrast [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Positive score (+1.03), but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (-1.41, contrib +1.01); caption check inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score (+2.66, contrib +0.91); 18/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Nuclear size variation** (regions 2, 3, 9) · context · Area CV 90th percentile [F8]; mean area 42 µm², 0th percentile [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu carcinoma (contrast case `BACH_0160`, 0.66 similarity) mimics stromal invasion where duct borders appear lost.
- Wrong-direction cell features (dead fraction 96th percentile [F9], epithelial fraction 3rd percentile [F10]) reflect segmentation artifacts.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 7, 10**: Confirm stromal invasion beyond ducts; approve drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders if confirmed.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 8**: Verify marked nuclear pleomorphism and inspect small, variable-sized nuclei measured in regions 2, 3, 9.
3. **Regions 3, 5, 9, 11**: Count mitoses directly (unreliable 0/20 model concept) and verify absent tubule formation in region 11.
